summary: The paymentservice pod kill caused a critical checkout outage with a 4.5% error rate and a 1.3‑second recovery, confirming the single‑replica weakness. The currencyservice failure produced a high‑severity outage, with a 38% error spike and a 30‑second recovery, again validating the critical single‑replica design. The checkoutservice kill was refuted; the system remained healthy with no error spike, indicating the current resilience is adequate.

findings.title: Paymentservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: The paymentservice pod was killed, causing a 4.5% error rate on checkout and a 1.3‑second recovery time.
findings.root_cause: The single‑replica payment processor failed, blocking payment and order completion.
evidence: frontend: {"error":"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.220.189:50051: connect: connection refused\"","http.req.id":"cdfe
findings.fix: Add a second replica and a PodDisruptionBudget to the paymentservice to prevent single‑point failure.

findings.title: Currencyservice pod failure
findings.what_happened: The currencyservice pod failed, leading to a 38% error rate on checkout and a 30‑second recovery.
findings.root_cause: The single‑replica currency conversion service stopped, blocking price calculation in checkout.
evidence: frontend: {"error":"could not retrieve currencies: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.54.127:7000: connect: connection refused\"","http.req.id":"c8a2af49-dcc0-4d87-b072-7c052755a18a"
findings.fix: Deploy a second replica for currencyservice and configure a PodDisruptionBudget to avoid single‑point failure.

findings.title: Checkoutservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: The checkoutservice pod was killed, but the system remained healthy with no error spike and a 1.3‑second recovery.
findings.root_cause: The single‑replica checkout orchestrator has a PodDisruptionBudget; the pod kill did not affect overall availability.
findings.fix: No fix needed; the current PDB protects checkoutservice from outages.
